claim: Google's Q3 2024 operating income was $28.5 million.
summary: Claim states Google's Q3 2024 operating income was $28.5 million. Based on internal knowledge, Alphabet (Google's parent) reported Q3 2024 operating income of approximately $28.5 billion (~$28,515 million), not million. The claim is off by a factor of ~1,000 and therefore contradicted.

sub_claims.text: Google's Q3 2024 operating income was $28.5 million
sub_claims.stated_text: Google's Q3 2024 operating income was $28.5 million
sub_claims.note: Internal knowledge: Alphabet Q3 2024 operating income was ~$28.52 billion (about $28,515 million), not $28.5 million. The $28.5 figure matches the billion-level result, indicating a million/billion unit error.
